decision.reasoning_trace: During my search, I encountered many products that were actually accessories like travel cases or power adapters rather than actual speakers. From the actual speakers available, I narrowed my choices down to those with high ratings and reliable feedback. The JBL Clip 3 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_147) immediately stood out due to its incredible social proof (over 68,000 reviews) and 4.7-star rating. While the BOGASING M4 offered more power (40W) and the EWA speaker was a great budget option, the portability and proven durability of the JBL Clip 3 for outdoor use made it the most convincing choice at its price point. The renewed JBL Flip 5 was also considered, but the risk associated with refurbished battery life mentioned in some reviews led me to prefer the brand-new Clip 3.
